name: Johnny Hooker
description: Brazilian artist Johnny Hooker brings his electrifying Euro Tour to the stage at Hard Club, located in the historic Ferreira Borges Market. Expect a vibrant and theatrical performance.
longDescription:
Brazilian singer-songwriter Johnny Hooker performs at Hard Club on September 12, 2026, as part of his Euro Tour. Known for his blend of pop, rock, and brega, Hooker's music often explores themes of love, desire, and identity. He gained prominence in the Brazilian music scene with his debut album and has since released several acclaimed works, establishing a distinctive artistic presence.

Attendees can expect a performance characterized by theatricality and high energy. The event takes place in the Hard Club, a music venue situated within the historic Ferreira Borges Market building in Porto. The atmosphere is typically lively, attracting an audience interested in contemporary Brazilian music and performance art.

This is a ticketed event. Hard Club is located in central Porto, within walking distance of São Bento train station and the Ribeira district. It is also accessible via public transport, with several bus lines stopping nearby.
